 Fans are fearing that Harry Potter star Emma Watson may have been hacked after a strange post on social media.
 The actress grew up in Oxford and attended the Dragon School before going to Headington School, where she studied for her GCSEs and A levels.
 Ms Watson also attended the city's branch of Stagecoach Theatre Arts before finding worldwide fame as Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter films.
 The 36-year-old joined Oxford University in 2023 to begin a master's in creative writing and later switched to a DPhil in literature.
 READ MORE: Geri Halliwell helped fund Christian Horner's career before they even met 
 View this post on Instagram
 A post shared by Emma Watson (@emmawatson) 
 It is rare that Ms Watson posts on her social media, with the actress preferring to keep her life private from the cameras.
 The famous Oxford student has uploaded an Instagram post this afternoon but has left fans fearing she may have been hacked.
 This upload consisted of a carousel of three photos, all in low resolution and showing shots from the upcoming film Wicker.
 The movie, which is released in UK cinemas on Friday (October 30), stars Olivia Colman, Alexander Skarsgård, Elizabeth Debicki, Marli Siu, Nabhaan Rizwan, Richard E. Grant, and Peter Dinklage.
 READ MORE: Jeremy Clarkson banned following controversial comments 
 Ms Watson's caption cryptically featured no words but several emojis instead, accompanying the blurry pictures.
 One fan said: "I fear she’s been hacked guys…"
 Another agreed: "Are you hacked or something lol?"
 "I don't know if the account is hacked, but I love you," said a third.
